# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 W5 phase 1, the Eastern Mediterranean and the Danube. Generated by gen_eastmed.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 W5 phase 2 (Wallachia: Arges, the Holy Mountain, Mircea in the interregnum, the sultan's revenge; events 1 and 3) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 W5 phase 3 (Cyprus in the 15th century: Khirokitia, a bride from the Morea, Famagusta returns; events 12 and 13, the hidden worker 90) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 19); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, void checks, close; then the counters, the world steps, and at most
# one event in a calm, free month.
oe_emd_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_live } } set_global_variable = oe_emd_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_on } } set_variable = oe_emd_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        oe_emd_void_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1467.1.1 AND = { has_variable = oe_emd_w_void has_variable = oe_emd_c_void } } }
            set_variable = oe_emd_off
            debug_log = "oe_emd: the line is closed"
        }
        else = {
            oe_emd_books = yes
            oe_emd_world = yes
            oe_emd_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A part becomes void when its preconditions fail before it is over (design 3.2; phase-1 end dates).
oe_emd_void_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_w_void } current_date < 1420.1.1 oe_emd_w_over = no oe_emd_w_pre = no }
        set_variable = oe_emd_w_void
        debug_log = "oe_emd: the Wallachian part is void"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_c_void } current_date < 1467.1.1 oe_emd_c_over = no oe_emd_c_pre = no }
        set_variable = oe_emd_c_void
        debug_log = "oe_emd: the Cypriot part is void"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The months each event has waited since its world step.
oe_emd_books = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_3 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_3 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_2 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_12 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_12 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_11 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_11 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_11 add = 1 } }
    # phase 3: the empire's modifier for its princess in Nicosia goes when the queen dies (design 3.7)
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_emd_greek_queen oe_emd_queen_alive = no }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_emd_greek_queen
        debug_log = "oe_emd: the queen in Nicosia is dead; the empire's modifier is removed"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one in a calm month while the lock is free (design 3.3).
oe_emd_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_12 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_emd_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_12 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_12 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 12 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_13 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_13 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 13 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_12 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.12 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_11 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 11 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.11 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 13 } oe_emd_pick_pair = yes if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_13 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 13 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.13 } else = { debug_log = "oe_emd: .13 was picked but what it needs could not be stored; it waits" } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.1 }
        remove_variable = oe_emd_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. w1 Rovine: the roll decides; no war, no subject relation (decision 183, note item 5).
oe_emd_w1_do = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } remove_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine }
    random = { chance = oe_emd_rovine_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine }
        c:WAL ?= { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
        c:TUR ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 2 }
        c:TUR ?= { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
        c:WAL ?= {
            add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_emd_wal_usurper years = 2 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. c1 Peter I's accession: Hugh IV gives the throne to his son (1358.11.24; only an AI Cyprus while Hugh IV
# reigns; Hugh IV is not killed).
oe_emd_c1_do = {
    c:CYP = { set_new_ruler = character:cyp_pierre_i }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_peter_king value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. c3 Alexandria (1365.10): looted for 3 years; the Mamluks resent Cyprus, Venice its lost trade; prestige for
# Cyprus and the Knights. D4's fallback W-3 yields to oe_emd_live (D4 phase 2).
oe_emd_c3_do = {
    location:alexandria = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_emd_bw_alexandria target = c:CYP } }
    c:CYP = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
    c:KNI ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus } }
    c:VEN ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_emd_bw_alex_trade target = c:CYP } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_alexandria value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. c5 Famagusta to Genoa (around 1373, the peace of 1374): the owner changes, Cyprus pays Genoa six months of
# its income or what it has.
oe_emd_c5_do = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_emd_amt value = oe_emd_cyp_indemnity }
    c:CYP = {
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_emd_amt multiply = -1 }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
    }
    c:GEN = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_emd_amt
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    }
    location:famagusta = { change_location_owner = c:GEN }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_famagusta value = 1 }
}

# ---- phase 2 (Wallachia)
# BYZ scope. w0 Arges: the Hungarian army of 1330 ruined the court at Arges and the seat moved to Campulung; after 1340
# the walls and a new court were built at Arges (design row W5; only an AI Wallachia at peace that still sits at
# Campulung and owns Arges).
oe_emd_w0_do = {
    c:WAL = { set_capital = location:arges }
}
# BYZ scope. w2: Mircea backs a claimant of the interregnum, the third if still in the race, else the second (never
# the one on the throne): +10 through B3's interface, once. oe_emd_w2_pick only records who (also used by the test
# button when the step itself cannot run).
oe_emd_w2_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_bet_alive_3 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_mircea_n value = 3 }
        var:oe_bet_c3 = { save_scope_as = oe_emd_pr_s }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_bet_alive_2 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_mircea_n value = 2 }
        var:oe_bet_c2 = { save_scope_as = oe_emd_pr_s }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_emd_pr_s } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pr value = scope:oe_emd_pr_s } }
}
oe_emd_w2_do = {
    oe_emd_w2_pick = yes
    oe_emd_pr_push = { amount = 10 }
}
# BYZ scope. w3 the sultan's revenge (1417 in history, after Mircea had helped the pretender Mustafa in 1416):
# Wallachia becomes a tributary of the Ottomans. No land changes hands (design 1.3).
oe_emd_w3_do = {
    c:WAL = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary } }
    c:TUR = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tribute value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. The strength of the prince Mircea backs changes by $amount$ (B3's oe_bet_push; nothing once the bet is closed).
oe_emd_pr_push = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_mircea_n global_var:oe_emd_mircea_n = 2 has_variable = oe_bet_s2 } oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_mircea_n global_var:oe_emd_mircea_n = 3 has_variable = oe_bet_s3 } oe_bet_push = { n = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 b: Byzantium backs the same prince (B3's rule: the commitment starts again from 0), then commits once
# (+1, the prince +5).
oe_emd_pr_join = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_mircea_n global_var:oe_emd_mircea_n = 2 } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_mircea_n global_var:oe_emd_mircea_n = 3 } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 3 } }
        oe_bet_add_stake = { amount = 1 push = 5 }
    }
}

# ---- phase 3 (Cyprus in the 15th century)
# BYZ scope. c6 Khirokitia (7 July 1426): the three towns Cyprus still owns are looted for 3 years; Cyprus pays the
# Mamluks a ransom of twelve months of its income or what it has, and carries oe_emd_cyp_tribute for 31 years (to
# 1458). No subject relation (design 3.5: vanilla flavor_mam.3 needs a free Cyprus).
oe_emd_c6_do = {
    location:limassol = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CYP } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    location:larnaca = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CYP } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    location:nicosia_cyp = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CYP } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_emd_amt value = oe_emd_cyp_ransom }
    c:CYP = {
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_emd_amt multiply = -1 }
        add_prestige = prestige_severe_penalty
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_emd_cyp_tribute years = 31 mode = replace }
    }
    c:MAM = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_emd_amt
        add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_khirokitia value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. c7 Famagusta returns (1464): the town goes back to Cyprus; nothing else changes.
oe_emd_c7_do = {
    location:famagusta = { change_location_owner = c:CYP }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_famagusta value = 2 }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget the pair of .13.
oe_emd_pair_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_groom } remove_variable = oe_emd_groom }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_bride_c } remove_variable = oe_emd_bride_c }
}
# BYZ scope. Pick the pair of .13 into BYZ variables (design 3.6): the groom is Cyprus's ruler if he fits, else its
# heir; the bride is the eldest woman of the emperor's dynasty who fits. Called by the monthly check just before it
# fires .13, and by the test button.
oe_emd_pick_pair = {
    oe_emd_pair_clear = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CYP }
        c:CYP = {
            ruler ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_emd_groom_fit = yes }
                    save_temporary_scope_as = oe_emd_tmp
                    c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_emd_groom value = scope:oe_emd_tmp } }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { c:BYZ = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_groom } } }
                heir ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { oe_emd_groom_fit = yes }
                        save_temporary_scope_as = oe_emd_tmp
                        c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_emd_groom value = scope:oe_emd_tmp } }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ruler_or_heir_if_regent.dynasty ?= {
        ordered_character_in_dynasty = {
            limit = { oe_emd_bride_fit = yes }
            order_by = age_in_days
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_temporary_scope_as = oe_emd_tmp
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_emd_bride_c value = scope:oe_emd_tmp } }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_emd.90: the heavy part of an option, by var:oe_emd_do (13 = .13 a, the marriage). No
# debug_log here: a player's click reaches it (CMDLOG). The pair is tested again, since the pop-up may have waited.
oe_emd_do_job = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_emd_do ?= 13 oe_emd_pair_ok = yes country_exists = c:CYP }
        var:oe_emd_groom = { save_scope_as = oe_emd_groom_s }
        var:oe_emd_bride_c = {
            move_country = c:CYP
            marry_character_ignore_blocks = scope:oe_emd_groom_s
            set_variable = oe_emd_queen
        }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_emd_greek_queen years = 15 mode = replace }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_helena value = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_do } remove_variable = oe_emd_do }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_emd_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. The bonds with Wallachia and Cyprus, 0-3 (later lines read them: L5, N4).
oe_emd_wal_tie_up = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_wal_tie } } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie min = 0 max = 3 }
}
oe_emd_cyp_tie_up = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_cyp_tie } } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie min = 0 max = 3 }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs); phase 2 adds a second line, phase 3 a third.
oe_emd_log = { debug_log = "oe_emd m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_m')|0] ws=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0] w=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_w_flags')|0] c=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_c_flags')|0] tie=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_wal')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_cyp')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st2')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st11')|0] side=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_rov')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_fam')|0] void=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_void')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_last')|0]" debug_log = "oe_emd p2 ws2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws2')|0] st1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st1')|0] athos=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_athos')|0] st3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st3')|0] mircea=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_mircea')|0]" debug_log = "oe_emd p3 ws3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws3')|0] c=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_c_flags')|0] st12=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st12')|0] kh=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_kh')|0] st13=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_st13')|0] bride=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_bride')|0] helena=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_helena')|0] pair=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_pair')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. Run a world step now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_emd_test_w0 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w0 } debug_log = "oe_emd test: w0 is already recorded ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws2')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_emd_w0_ok = yes } oe_emd_w0_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: w0 cannot run now (a player involved, a precondition or a war)" }
}

# BYZ scope. Show .2: Rovine runs first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot (in 1337 the Ottomans do not border
# Wallachia), only its result is rolled, for the text, and nothing in the world changes.
oe_emd_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1 } oe_emd_w1_ok = yes } oe_emd_w1_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } }
        random = { chance = oe_emd_rovine_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 2 } }
        debug_log = "oe_emd test: Rovine could not run as a world step; its result was rolled for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.2 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .2 cannot be shown (Wallachia is gone)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .11: Famagusta goes to Genoa first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot, the result is recorded

# BYZ scope (phase 2). Show .3: w2 runs first if it can (the bet's month is ignored); when it cannot (in 1337 the
# Ottomans do not border Wallachia) but round 1 of the bet runs, the prince is only recorded, for the text, and the bet
# is not touched. Needs the interregnum's bet open (test page: the b3 buttons).
oe_emd_test_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w2 } oe_emd_w2_pre = yes } oe_emd_w2_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_mircea_n } oe_emd_w2_bet = yes }
        oe_emd_w2_pick = yes
        debug_log = "oe_emd test: w2 could not run as a world step; the prince was recorded for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_3 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.3 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .3 cannot be shown (it needs round 1 of the bet running with a second or third prince in the race)" }
}

# BYZ scope (phase 3). Show .13 now: the window, the calm and the AI test are left out; the pair is picked by the real
# rules. Without a pair only a log line is written (oe_emd_rd_pair: ones a groom was found, tens a bride).
oe_emd_test_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    oe_emd_pick_pair = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_13 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.13 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .13 cannot be shown, no pair by the real rules (pair [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_pair')|0]: ones groom, tens bride)" }
}
# BYZ scope (phase 3). Show .13 with a loose pair, to read the text and to try the marriage where the real rules find
# nobody (a 1337 start): any unmarried grown man of Cyprus, any unmarried grown woman of the empire who is not its ruler.
oe_emd_test_13x = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    oe_emd_pair_clear = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CYP }
        c:CYP = {
            random_character = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_female = no is_adult = yes is_married = no }
                save_temporary_scope_as = oe_emd_tmp
                c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_emd_groom value = scope:oe_emd_tmp } }
            }
        }
    }
    random_character = {
        limit = { is_alive = yes is_female = yes is_adult = yes is_married = no is_ruler = no }
        save_temporary_scope_as = oe_emd_tmp
        c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_emd_bride_c value = scope:oe_emd_tmp } }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_13 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.13 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .13 cannot be shown, no loose pair either (pair [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_pair')|0]: ones groom, tens bride)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state and the world-step records (what the world steps changed in the world stays;
# phase 3: the empire's own modifier oe_emd_greek_queen goes, the marriage itself stays).
oe_emd_test_reset = {
    remove_variable = oe_emd_on
    remove_variable = oe_emd_off
    remove_variable = oe_emd_m
    remove_variable = oe_emd_w_void
    remove_variable = oe_emd_c_void
    remove_variable = oe_emd_last
    remove_variable = oe_emd_pick
    remove_variable = oe_emd_rov_side
    remove_variable = oe_emd_fam_side
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wal_tie
    remove_variable = oe_emd_cyp_tie
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_3
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_3
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_2
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_2
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_12
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_12
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_11
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_11
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_13
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_1
    remove_variable = oe_emd_athos
